sn_aia_tool.description: Reads skipped upgrade records from the last run and re-checks if they are still relevant or out-of-date. Compares current plugin state against available updates to determine if the skip reason still applies.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"plan_id","description":"The upgrade plan identifier to look up skipped items from (optional - defaults to most recent)","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Scan Skipped Items
